common_act1_01.scene: A hooded peddler at a small wooden stall examining empty glass medicine bottles, brown sediment in the bottles, hospital corridor behind, side view

common_act1_16.scene: A few worn metal tokens on the hospital floor, blank faceless circular surfaces, caregiver shadow nearby, close view

lucian_personal_1.scene: A traveling caregiver wrapping a patient arm with clean bandage, plain oil bottle left unopened, patient turning away from a small sacred emblem
